thin: Reentry lists are the thinnest of the four: no Mesa or East Valley list exists, the County and Sheriff pages give names only, 211 returned nothing in Mesa, the ADCRR reentry page returned 403, and the only Mesa provider any list named (The Mesa House) came from a coffee shop's community page and is missing from Scout. Most names on the lists are Phoenix programmes or general employment and sober-living agencies that fail the main-service rule. Hand corrections: Mesa House, New Horizons, CareerOneStop and Traditions were false matches set to none.
